beats.event: Runt of the litter; John Arable comes to slaughter him
Fern saves his life and raises him as a pet
Sold on to Fern's uncle Homer Zuckerman
Lonely in the barn, missing Fern
Ram tells him Zuckerman is fattening him for slaughter
Charlotte the spider promises to save his life
Charlotte weaves SOME PIG above his pen
Crowds flock to the barn to see the miracle web
Charlotte weaves TERRIFIC into the web
Charlotte weaves RADIANT into the web
Zuckerman enters him in the county fair
At the fair Charlotte spins HUMBLE above his stall
Judges award him a special prize
The prize means Zuckerman will never slaughter him
Charlotte, exhausted and dying, entrusts him with her egg sac
Charlotte dies alone at the fairgrounds
Winter passes; Charlotte's babies hatch in the barn
Three spiderlings stay; he has friends for years
